sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
வேதிகைக்கு வேலியான முல்லைவனன் மனோகரியே
வேதமூலமே நாத சாரமே ஜனன பாலினியே
sections.translit:
vEdhikaikku vEliyAna mullaivanan maNogariyE
vEdhamUlamE nAdha sAramE janana pAliniyE
sections.en: Darling of Lord Mullaivana Nathar, you were protective like a fence around Rishi Nidhruva’s pregnant wife Vedhikai. You are the origin of all the Vedas. You are the essence of music and the universal guardian of all births.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
குழந்தைப் பேறருளி நிறை மாதமும் அக்
கொழுந்தை காத்திடும் திருக்கருகாவூர் திருவே
sections.translit:
kuzhandhaip pERaruLi niRai mAdhamum ak
kozhundhai kAtthidum thirukkarukAvUr thiruvE
sections.en: Oh, Goddess of Thirukarukavur, you bless women to have a child, and protect their wombs until the child is born.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
முனி ஒருவன் கோபத்தால் சபித்தாலும்
இனி ஒருக்காலும் இடர் அணுகா என்றே
புனித குடத்திடை கருவினை இருத்திக் காத்து
புத்துயிர் ஈந்த பூவையே கர்ப்ப ரக்ஷகியே
sections.translit:
muni oruvan kObatthAl sabitthAlum
ini orukkAlum idar aNugA endRE
punidha kudatthidai karuvinai irutthik kAtthu
putthuyir Indha pUvaiyE garba rakshakiyE
sections.en: Although Rishi Urdhvapada angrily cursed the pregnant Vedhikai, you reassured her that no harm would come to her. You safely separated the fetus from her womb, stored it in a sacred pot, and guarded it to stay safe until childbirth. You created a new life. You are a compassionate goddess, stewarding all pregnancies.

notes: This song is based on the sthalapuranam of Sri Garbarakshambikai temple in Thirukarukavur, located in the Tanjore District. Siva and Parvathi blessed Rishi Nidhruva and his wife Vedhika after a long marriage with a pregnancy. During her third trimester, Rishi left home to meet the demi-god Varuna. Another rishi, Urdhvapada, came to the Ashram to meet Nidhruva. Vedhika was tired and resting. She did not see the rishi arrive and did not welcome him. Annoyed, the angry saint cursed her for her indifference towards him. The rishi cursed her with the dreaded “Rayatchu” disease. Vedhika cried and pleaded for his forgiveness in vain. She begged Goddess Parvathi to protect her and her child. The goddess separated the baby from the womb and kept it in a sacred pot until the time of delivery. A healthy baby was born at the right time. Rishi Nidhruva learnt all this background from his wife after his return. Vedikai begged Goddess Parvathi to stay in Thirukarukavur and bless all of the needy women expecting a baby, and so the Goddess did exactly that. For details, see: Mullaivana Nathar Temple Sthalapuranam The story of Garbarakshambigai Amman
